observations: The error was invisible to every reader because the same string is correct one directory higher: `../../AGENTS.md` resolves from docs/architecture/ and lands on nothing from docs/architecture/p0/. Copying scaffolding down a level is how it spread to all fourteen files.
It survived a fresh-context review of every one of those fourteen designs. A reviewer reads what a link says, not where it goes; only a machine follows every one.
This is what the drift survey meant by link checking stopping at HTML. The first guard built for that gap found 48 real defects before it had a single test.
decisions: DEC-103: the pack's links climb three levels; nothing else changes, and no design's version moves.
assumptions: A link's target is what lies between ]( and ), and a fragment after # belongs to the target rather than the path.

stop_if: The same substitution is applied outside docs/architecture/p0/; `../../` is correct one level higher.

declared_non_coverage: No prose, status, version or heading changed; only the text between ]( and ).
External links were not checked; they need the network and are a different problem.
Fragments were confirmed to exist in their targets for the eight distinct targets repaired, not for every link in the repository; that belongs to the guard of #310.
Nothing here stops the mistake recurring. The guard does, and it is blocked on this.
